capabilities: Bundle notes by folder, tag, or note plus its links
Format the bundle as Markdown or XML
Estimate token count and check it against model limits
Strip embeds and images from the output
Save packs with stored source and options for rebuilding
extras: Token counts are approximations (about four characters per token, whitespace collapsed), not a real tokenizer, so headroom is needed near a limit. The two shipped model-limit entries are placeholders and must be edited.
problem: Copying several notes into a chat prompt by hand is slow and gives no indication of whether the text fits a model's context window.
summary: Bundles selected vault notes into one LLM-ready text block in Markdown or XML, with a token estimate and context-limit checks.
